newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.1 Nov 22 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.1 Nov 22 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 106.1 in the week ended November 22 from a revised 105.5 figure in the previous week, ECRI said.
A faster growth rate in real estate loans and an increase in the growth rate of industrial prices helped push the index up, ECRI said.
"While a cyclical upturn in inflation is still unlikely at this time, the FIG needs to be watched carefully in the weeks ahead for early signs of intensification in inflationary pressures," it said.
